KA JINGSNENG TYUMEN Wat ju ai huspai ia ka kiad ban hang, Ba ha ka, ka um, ka ding, ki don lang, Wat iu leh kfdain eh ia ka um ka ding, Ba ioh phi hap pat lyndang pat pyrshing. Wat ju samai ho ha ka dihkynja, Ba ioh lap ka ringsdot pukir-pukra; Wat ham wat dih aphin, shandu, mudot, Ba ka met ka sdot, ka r'ta ka lyngkot.

Wat ju lei* marmlien ka syat ia-khalai, Ba don ha ka, ka hiamra ringswai; Wat Ju mlien ha ka iaid awria uwman, Ba sniew ka met had wir spah noh pynhan; Wat ju iashang khah bad ki jong ki hriew, Ba ioh ka lap ka ruma ka phohsniew ; Nangta sah sa ka rain ka thuhkhana, Lyntertait haroh shijunom hura Kine haroh hynriew tylli ki kpait, Kiha lah eh ban pynjot ingkhong khait. “BALEI NGA NGEIT HA KA NIAM TYNRAI” Da U B. NiKHLA, B.Sc.. Joint Secretary, Sein Raj Shillong Branch Ngi ki Khasi-Pnar ngi long kawei ka jaidbynriew ba kyr- pang. Ngi don ka jingngeit ba ia ngi la phah beit beil da U Trai Nongbuh Nongthaw na bneng ban wan sha kane ka pyrlhei lyngba ki kpa lymmen )ong ngi ki “Nicw Skum Niew Trep”. Namar kata ngi dei ki khun jong U Blei hi. Namar dei hangne ba la seng ia ki niam ki rukom, ki riti ki dustur naduh mynbarim bajah bad ba la pyndap shuh shuh ia kine ki rilum baieit jongngi da ka jing- khuid bad ka jingshisha. Ki Khasi-Pnar ki long kiba iai- shah, kiba lui lui bad kiba bat ia la ka juban lak. Shisien ba ki ia khlei ia la u thylliej ksiar kim ju nguid shuh ia u arsien. Ha ki ka “hooid” ka long shisha ka “hooid” bad ka “em” ka long shisha ka “em”. Ki jingeh bad ki dumok ka por kim lah satia ban buhrieh ia kane ka jingshisha. Kane ka jinglong ka pyni ba ki Khasi-Pnar ki long ki khun U Blei.

U Khasi-Pnar hyndai la u tare hapoh ka tlip tlip, pynban u long uba la don ka jingshai. Namar ha ka maia u iohi ia U Blei bad u seng ia ki niam ki rukom, ki riti ki dustur bad ia ka khein jait khein kynja da kaba iasyllok bad U. U icng ha ka nongrim ba la ai ia u da U Blei hi kata “Kamai ia ka hok”. Kane ka long ka daw balei ba kane ka jaidbyn- rievv ka dang iai neh ka dang iai im wat la pynshitom ia ka da ki bun spah snem hapoh ka jingsynshar jong ki nongwei. Kane ka jaidbynriew kan dang iai im katba ka dang lah ban bat ia la ki niam ki rukom, ki riti ki dustur ba ia ai ha ka da U Blei hi. Kumta ngi dei ban icng ha la ki jong ki kjat. Ngin lum ia ka jingtip ba ngi donkam na kano kano ka jaid-bynriew ha pyrthei, hynrei ngim dei satia ban klet ba ngi dei ki Khasi- Pnar kiba don la ki jong ki niam ki dustur. Uwei-pa-uwei u Khasi-Pnar u don la ka kam ban leh. Ki hajar ki kpa tym- men ki kmie tymmen ki long- shwa ki man-shwa ki jongngi, kiba la bam kwai hakhmat U Blei, ki peit ia man la ki kam ba ngi leh. Ki kmen bad ki sngewbha haba ki iohi ba np ki long-dien ngi pynbha pyni- tynnad ia ki matti jongki ha kane ka pyrthei. Hynrei ki sngewsih kthang pat de ban iohi ba lada ngi pyrshang ban pyndam noh ia ki. Ngi don shibun kiei kiei ban tip na kiwei pat.

U briew uba kyntait ban tip na kiwei pat uta um dei satia u briew. Hynrei ngim dei ban shah ba kine ki jingtip ba ngi lum na kiwei kin synshar iangi. Dei mangi ki ban syn- shar ia ki. “Wat kyrkich, wat pyrthuh ia kiwei pat”, kane ka dei kawei ka jinghikai ba ngi dei ban kynmaw. Ka jing- pyrthuh kam long satia ka jing- shai. Nga lah ban riam ialade kum u syiem hynrei kane kam pynlong ia nga u syiem. U Suri ha ka snieh langbrot um dei satia u langbrot. Ka jing- pyrthuh kum u khaw-pud ka long ka dak jong ka jinghiar shapoh, ka dak jong ka jing- troin jong ka jaidbynriew. Ha- ba u briew u la sdang ban isih ialade, u la sdang ban isih ia la ki kpa tymmen, u la sdang ban bein ia la ki thawlang ki iawbei, ka jingkut ka la wan, ka jaid- bynriew ka la ngam shapoh khyndew. Hato don kiba kwah ban iohi ba kane ka jaidbyn- riew jong ngi kan jah noh! Kumta, para, kyndit joit ne jot noh thiaw! Namarkata nyngkong eh to ngin ia bat ia ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem-ia la ki niam ki rukom ki riti ki dustur kiba ngi nud ban kam trai ba dei ki jong ngi hi kiba ngi ioh kynti na la ki longshwa manshwa kiba la wan sha kane ka pyrthei ban kamai ia ka hok.

Namar dei tang kane ka ban pynneh pynsah ia ka jinglong Nylla jong ngi. “La^ ngim bat beit ia la ka Niam tynrai, la i kur ruh kumno ngin sharai.” Lada ngim lah ban sharai la i kur ia ka jaid- bynriew la jong kumno ngin sharai. Ki nongwei naduh hyndai ki la pyrshang bad iai pyrshang ban iuh roit noh ia kane ka jaidbynriew jongngi hapoh ki kjat jong ki haduh ba ki riewmadan jongngi ki Ja klet noh ba ma ki ki dei ki khun ki ksiew u hynniew trep Niew- skum — ki khun U Blei. La teh ia ki bad met bad mynsiem. La pynlong ia ki kum ki nongthOh- dieng bad ki nongtong um ia ki kynrad nongwei jong ki. Kane ka la pynlong ia ki ban pyrkhat ba la kha ia ki ban long ki mraw iano re iano. Ki la klet ba maki ki dei ki khun jong U Blei. Da kaba i kwah ia ka jong kiwei pat , ka apot sepngi ka la hap ha ki. To ngin ia kyndit bynriew para, kam dei satia ka por ban thiah. Don ka jingngeit ba phi long ki riewshlur kiba la kha ban leh shibun ki kam bakhraw. Wat ai ba ka jingwiar i ksew barit kan pyntieng ia phi. Na- mar dei ha ka kam jong ngi mynta ka sdien ka jingim jong ka ri Khasi-Pnar kaba lashai la shisngi.

Ai ba ka pyrthei kan tip lyngba ki kam babha jong ngi ba don kata ka jaid bynriew kaba la phah kyrpang da U Blei sha kane ka Pyrthei bad ka dang don haduh mynta. Wat ai ba ka kyntien ka jong- phi kan kren khamjam ban ia ki kam ki jong phi , hynrei ai ba ki kam ki jongphi kin kyang kin pyrta sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ba ngi long ki khlur ban lam lynti ia ka pyrthei ha ka Hang ka tip-briew tip-Blei, ha ka Hang ka akor ka burom. 32 KA NONGKYLLIANG KajingkrenIRaogbah A.S.KIiongphai, B. Advocate, President, Seng Khasi,ha ka 26th January 1969 ha Seng Khasi Hall, Mawkhar, Shillong Ka ktien kyUiang, ka dei ka adverb bad lah ruh ban pyn- donkarn kum ka noun, kaba mut ka jingai kylliang ne shim kylliang. Ka ktien kylliang hi ka mut ia kaei kaei kaba ngi dci ban pynphai pat. Ka ktien nong, kum ka noun ka mut ka bai nong-bai ni ia kaba ngi trei ; u briew uba trei u dei ban ioh la ka nong. Kumta ka ktien nong ba ju buh na khmat (prefix) haba pyniasoh bad ka ktien kylliang ka don ka jing- mut kaba iar bad khia katta- katta. Kumta kane ka ktien ka mut ka bainong ba uno-uno nc kano-kano kin ioh kumba ki la trei hok ne pap, hok-hok, pap-pap, phin ioh la ka nong- kylliang. Ha ka ktien pahreng kaba kham jan ka dei recipro- city, kaba mut ka jingialeh ne ia ai markylliang, kum ha ka kha-i pateng hapdeng kawei ka hima bad kawei pat ha kaba ki ju pynduh kaba shim khajna markylliang (action and reaction; the discharge of mutual duties or obliga- tions, as between two individuals or parties; equal en- joyment of mutual ri^ts or benefits, especially in interna- tional trade, equal facilities or advantages by abolition of prohibitory or protective du- ties, or by equalizing the rates in each country). Kawei pat ha ka ktien phareng ka long retribution, kaba mut ka jing- siew kylliang ne jingioh kyl- liang lada ia kaba bha ne ba sniew. Ka long ka jingsuk ne jingshilom lawei ba u briew ne ka briew ki dei ban ioh na ka bynta la ki kam ne jingleh ba bha nc ba sniew. (repay- ment, reward, return suitable to the merits or deserts of an action, as reward or punish- ment.

It is a state of happi- ness or of misery in another world allotted to man accor- ding to their deserts (worths, dues) while living on earth). Kane ka ktien retribution ka kham ia hap bad ka ktien nong- kylliang jong ngi ki Khasi. fo don bun ki ktien ba pyniasoh bad ka ktien kylliang kum, mat kylliang— a child, a repre- sentative, pan kylliang, shim kylliang, leh kylliang bad kumta ter ter. Ka ktien kylliang hi ka mut— ban pynphai ia ka ram to return as a loan. Ka nong- kylliang, haduh mynta kham- tam ha ki nongkyndong ka mut lada u briew u wan trei iarap, khlem bai nong saw sngi ha iing jong phi, phi ruh phi dei ban leit trei pat saw sngi ha iing jong u kum ka nongkylliang. Ki tym- men ki ju ong ba kumba u briew u la leh, u la trei un ioh la ka nongkylliang Ha ka jingngeit jong ngi ki Khasi, ngi shem ba ym don mano-mano ba lah ban bah khala ia ngi, hynrei dei tang ngi ma lade bad-da lade hi: kunita, “la kano kano ka jingsnicw ne ka pap ba phi la kum leh, lada haba rieh nc ba paw ne ba dum; ia kano-kano ka jingjynjar ba phi shem, la ka dei kaba eh ne kaba jem wat ju leit pynkil pap halor kiwei pat, ioh ka wan hap ha lade ka suhsat; kaba pynkit khoh pei halor kiwei pat, shi- sien ka sngi ha lade hi kan wan ngal”. Kiba khmieh bad nujor bha kin ioh-i ba U Blei U Trai Kyn- rad, U Nongbuh, U Nongthaw, U Balah U Baiai U la buh ha kane ka pyrthei ka mariang ia ki diengsoh, diengsyntirew, ki soh, ki syntiew la ka jong ka Jong , hynrei baroh ki siew- kylliang bad iaroh ia la U Nongthaw; khmieh ia ki soh bad syntiew ba bun Jr it bun rong bad la jingiwbih ki suh- sieng, kumjuh ruh ki sim ba bun jait ba bun rong, ki rwai iaroh bad siewkylliang ia la u Nong- thaw, hynrei tang ma ngi ki briew la ngi long ki kynrad halor ki jingthaw baroh , pynban ngi long ki bym suidniew ban siew kylliang da kaba biang ia la U Nongthaw, “Pleng ka dei ia nga kein ba ngan iaid da kaba biang, man ka sngi, man u bnai, man ka snem ba ngan ioh diang , kumba nga la long dei ngan ioh ka nongkylliang”, Ki Khasi ki sneng ki kraw, ki ju ong ba iaki ’tien sneng wat ju bakla,-- namar ba ki tieng ia ka nongkylliang-Ki ju sneng naduh ba ngi dang rit ba ha iing ha sem ban ia ieit ia kren ki ’tien donburom bym bit ban ong “mame” ne “ma- pha” ia shynrang ne kynthei lane shi para. Haba ai jing- bam ki kmie ki kpa, la ki ai katno-katno ym bit banleh sa, ha ba kwah jingbam ruh ki ju ong wat ju marmlien ban shim hi ne ban ia knieh, wat ju lalot kangar jyndei, ki ong, ioh pang khrew. Kim ju shah ban bam seh ba ioh raid noh, ym khlain ne synter shuh bad ki briew ruh kin kynshi iathuh khana, “Iw kum ki khun bym ju ioh ja”. Ki sneng ruh ba ngin sngewrit kynthop ban ym mlien ka sngew meng sngew sarong, bad kane ka jingmlien ka dei ka kam ba kin khmieh ki kmie ki kpa na la iing nyngkong. Lada ki kmie ki leh bad lah ban leh ia kane ki la jop Ipa shiteng ha ka thma ka jingim bad kin ioh ka nongkylliang kaba biang bad ki soh bathiang. Iathuh ha nga ki kmie ki kpa ki la long ne long kiba kumno?

bad ngan iathuh ki khun kin long kiba kumno. Ki kmie ki kpa kiba sneng ba kraw ia la ki khun naduh ba ki dang- lung, kiba ai ka sneng ka kraw kaba bha, kiba ai ka jingbam mynsiem kaba bha, kiba ai ki jingmut jingpyrkhat ba bha, kiba pynmlien ha ki rukom ba bha, kiba nang ban ai ka bam ka dih ba bha, ka akor kaba bha, khlem pep kin ioh la ka nongkylliang, ba suh 34 sieng jingiwbih ba thiang, bad kata ka dei kein ka nongkylliang ba ki khun kin siew kylliang ynda ki la heh la saniban bsa ban btiah ia la ki kmie ki kpa ynda ki la tymmrn Ka pyrthel hi ka long ka kper syntiew ba itynnad haba ia ieit ha iing. U mali uba bha, uba sumar uba phut uba pynkhuid ia ki nuit ki nier, uba ai sboh, ai um, uba ker bha la ka kpcr ban ym ioh pynjot ki mrad ki mreng, uba khie thiah dangstep phyr- ngab, uba ap bad trci baroh shi sngi, uba khang khop ia la ka phalor mynmiet, khlem pep un hun bad ki briew ruh kin iaroh ban ioh-i ia ka kper soh kper syntiew ba bun jait ki rong ba itynnad ba bang bad la ki jingiewbih ba suhsieng. Ki iaroh ia la u nongsumar bad kumjuh ia la U Nongthaw. U nongrep ba smat ba sting uba puh ba lur ia la ka lyngkha dang step Dhyrngab, uba bet ia u symbai ja bha, uba sumar mict sngi, u bym shah ia ki phreit, ki sim ne ki mrad ki mreng ban pyn- duh ne pynjulor ia u kba, uba ai ka um kaba biang, uba pyn- khuid ia ki fiuit ki nier khlem pep un ioh ot ia u kba ba bha. Kum- juh ruh u briew uba thuiig ia ki diengsoh diengpai ha ka por ba biang, uba pynkhuid ia ki niut ki nier, u bym shah ba ka mangkariang kan bam, khlem pep un ioh kheit kyrhai ia ki soh ba bang ba thiang bad ioh la ka nongkylliang. Ki briew ynda ki la sngew- nang sngewstad mynta ki la klet noh wat ia U Non^buh Nongthaw. Ngi la ioh kem ki jingstad ba ngi la ioh bad kiba ngin dang ioh shuh haduh ba ^ ka jingjngai na kawei ka jaka, na kawei ka it, na kawei ka muluk, na kawei ka hima, wat ia ka haw-haw kin ym long shuh kiba pynjngai ia ngi, na- mar ha ka jaka ban iaid ar taiew, lai taiew, ngi lah ban iaid mynta hapdeng ym ar ne lai sngi, hynrei ha pdeng ar bad lai kynta. Kine ki riewstad ki ioh kein ka nongkylliang da ki kam ba bha hynrei ngim dei ban sarong ne bein ia uta uba la pynlong ia ngi, ba ngi long kumba ngi la long. Ha ka Jaka ban ai khublei lok, haba leit phut bniat, namar mynhyndai ki iathuh ba u briew uba leit bad kwah ban phut bniat, namar ba u shitom at ka shyntur, bym ioh bam ioh dih bym ioh thiah ioh shong shuh, u da ia khublei ia ki lok ki jor, namar um tip un wan im ne long kumno. Ki teh da ki tyllai ia ki kti ki kjat ha jing- thiah bad ki kynjut da ki halai. Mynta kam long shuh kumta.

Katba ngi nangstad, ki khyl- lung ruh kim kham iap kynrei bad ka kmie ruh kam kham shitom, ka pyrthei ka nangroi bad u khun bynriew u nangbun. Ngi ioh kein la ka nongkylliang, da kaba ngi pyndonkam hok ia ka sap ka phong ba la ai U Nongthaw tangba ryngkat bad ka jingstad, ngi pyndonkam ha ka rukom ba dei ban iaroh ia la u Nongthaw. 35 Ki bor ba heh ki iaieh ia tan, ki khroh na kiba kin ioh myn- toi, uba rit u nangiap. Ki long kumjuh hi, kumba haba u mrad i.e. masi ba heh bad donbor u beh bad kyndat ia i khun masi iba rit haba i bam ia u ’lang lung uba u ikwah ban bam. Kumjuh kumba u suri haba u kwah ban bam ia i khun blang u wad daw kynroi bun jait, balei ba jakhlia ka um dih imat ba ita i khun blang i leit iuh ne pyntngit naneng bad haba i ong ba im shym la leh kumta namar ha ka jing- shisha i la dih um narum, katta ruh u suri u la ong ba lada im shym la Ich ma i, kata u kpa Jong i uba la mai ia u, la tim ia u myn shem snem kumta i dei ban siew dor wat da ka jingiap. Kumta ruh uba heh bor u lah ban kynroi thaw nia haba kiba rit bor ki iaieh, ki heh bor ki maham, ki byr- ngem bad ki lah ruh ban pyn- shitom, hynrei haba para ba ia ryngkat ki ia tyngkhuh ka kam ka shu kut noh khlem leh ei-e'i.Ngi la ioh-i ia kata ka nongkylliang ba ka League of Nations ka la kyllon bad ym artatien wat lada kane ka U.N.O. ka kyllon, lymda ka pyrkhat bad kynmaw sngi ia ka nongkylliang, ba kumba ki leh ia kiwei kiba rit bad tlot bor, ki ruh kin kyllon. Phin ioh-i ba ym lah ban ynduh daei-daei ia ka nong- ylliang, da ki ‘lei thawnang malade, lane ban leit bah khala da kiwei pat ia ki pop ki^yei. Kiba hikai ia kiwei, kiba kyn- shoit ia ki jingsniew, khJem pep kin wan kyrtoh hi ha lade. Lada phi shu ,niut shu khan, khlem leh, lehse yn ym da paw eh, hynrei lada phi leit lute leit dokhol ia ka it ka muluk, ka jaka kiwei pat, khlem ar- taticn ia ka Jong phi ruh ' n lute, dokhol, ne pynjot, shisien ka sngi da kiwei pat. Lada phi pynshitom leh bein ia kiba rit bor khlem sngap shuh ia ka nia hok iaphi ruh shisien ka sngi yn pynjot, pynshitom da kiwei pat ne da kito kijuh ki briew kiba phi la leh bein.

Ka history ka pyrthei , wat mynta hi da la ki khmat la jong ngi la ioh-i kumno ka ri Germany ka la long hadicn ka jingshah jop u Hitler ha ka snem 1945, bad kiwei ki hima bad bor pyrthei kiba heh ki la pra la kyllon ba ki la leh bein ia kiba rit ba ria, bad ba kim khein shuh ia ka sang ka pap. Lada phi hikai ban shun ban ibein ia la ki kmie ki kpa, ia ki khun jong phi ruh kumjuh yn don hi ki ban hikai kylliang kumjuh, bad kumta ki khun jongphi ruh kin shun, kin isih kylliang ia phi. Wat tang ban pyrkhat ibein ne bishni ia kiwei ruh ka bym bit, namar kin don kiwei pat ruh ki ban ibein kyl- liang ia phi khlem tip, lane ba maphi hi phin ym ioh tliiah suk shong suk haba phi la kum mut kumta. Kumta ka jingmut bha, jingleh bha ki don hi la ka nong, kata ban pynsuk ne pynshkitom hi ia la bad ha la ka jingmut la jong. Dei u briew hi uba pynlong ia kata ka 36 dujok ne ka bneng, kat kum ki jingmut jingpyrkhat, ki kam, ki akor ba u ia leh. Kumta lada ngi iui dem, iai pyrkhat, iai kren, iai leh hok, ngin him ba kane ka jingbishar ba donbor tam kaba ngi ong ka nongkjlliang (the supreme dispenser of justice) kan ai jing- suk ne jingshitom, kat kum ka jingmut, Jingkhan bad Jingleh jongphi, kan long ka nonglukai ia la ka iaid ka ieng hok ba bha la Jong , ban long lade kat u britw ne ka briew shisha ha pyrthei hapdeng u lok u jor, u kur u jait bad u kha u man. Ki tymmen ki ju sneng bym bit bad mano-mano ruh la shyn- rang ne kynthei, wat ju kit kyndang ne pynkit kyndang ia ka pap kiwei, wat ju pynkit la ka pap ha kiwei. La phi leh makna, katno-kanto ruh ka hok ka hok. ka pap ka pap, phin shu sah jeid pynban ei ia lade, kumta ha la ka hok to kit kyn- dong shaithop la ka jong phin ioh jingkyrkhu na tbian nc jrong . Ki tymmen ki sneng ba ngim dei ban brai jyndci ia ka biria thala, ba ioh ka jingmut ka shong per noh tang ha sla, wat ju iai mlicn eh ruh ka kticn khutia biria, ba ka jingim ka kylla tharia. Ym bit ban kren mler ka ktien iano-iano, lane ban jler ka ktien lano-lano, >m dei ruh ban kren ne leh khlem da sngewthuh ba ioh pawrain ei ha kaba khadduh. Ngim dei ban ralien ban shait ka lorni ba ioh shong seng ka long atlukhi.

Ia lade wat ju pyn- shong niangraidhob, ba ioh dain pong ia la ka lyngthohdoh, wat ju rhah ia ka jingioh kiwei ba ioh shah dain dong ei ha pyrthei, wat ju bishni ia kiwei ki britw, ba ioh pakhuh ei ha la ka khohsitw, wat ju ai huspai ia ka kiad ban bam ba ha ka ka um ka dingki ia don lang; wat ham v\'at dih aphin, shandu mudot,ba ka met ka sdot, ka rta ka lyngkot, wat ju mar- mlien ka syat iu khalia, ba ka dot! ha ka ka niamra ringswai. Ha ka jingshong kha shong man ki tymmen ki ong: Wat ju peit itynnad iano-iano, khlem da tip ia i kur i jait jongno, da kylli bha ia i kur bad ia ka ia sang. Wat ju ia poi kha lyngngoh thamulo, dei ban da tip u kni u kpa; w'at ju ia poi kha bad ki jait bym bha, hynrei para ba ia biang ka pylla. Haba shisien phi la leit iing britw wat ju leh bcin ia ka jait kiwei, ba ioh ka kyrtoh lyndet ha la ka kur ka jait. Ki ong ruh Wilt ju khmieh ibha hamer ba riam ba beit, ioh isih ynda ha ka leit ka wan. Haba poi kha ha i kur-no kur-no, wat ju iehbtiii wat ju ichnoh pyng- dir.g p>ngiuh ba sang, bym ia ithuh kha ithuh man shuh, bym ia ithuh khun ithuh kpa shuh. Kane kam dei tang ia ka iing ki briew ha la iing ruh kam pep ban wan jia sniew', lada uno-uno ii leit leh kum kata, ki khein nc niew ka kam u duhjait duh- kynja. Namar haba ia poi kha ki da duwai, kyrpad bad pan 37 na U Blci Trai Kynrad ban iar ban khraw u tnum u tyndai, ban khraw u synniang u byn- hei, ban long ka phur ka siang arliang kha rta-rta. Ki ong wat ju kynshi nc byn- thiew haba kiwei ki shem sniew, haba kren ne leh ia kiwei mynno ba tang ia kiwei kan leit dei kan kyrtoh ha lade hi kynmaw nongkylliang ka ju jia kylla la ka long kaba sniew ne kaba bha. Wat ju leh tlian ka kamai ka kajih, ym dei ruh ban pyn- lut phut ha ka bam ka dih ba ioh hap lynnong ka jingshipa ba ioh iap lum thadlad khlem kur khlem kha. Ym dei ruh ba ngin shaniah jyndei tang ha la ka mon, haramjat kum ka mon lait luid ym ju don, ka mon khlem nia kam ju niew ia ka pap ka sang, wat ia u pud ba la buh kiba rim ruh ka nud ban ryngkang.

To ruid ka jylli (circle) ha ka jingim bad wat jam palat ia uta u pud ka jylli— (Thus far and no further.) Ki ong ruh wat shaniah lut ha u lok ba bieit, ioh un die tad ia phi la u ieit, ha ki kam bah kam san lei-lui, kum ha uta wat ju shaniali madei. Ki ong ruh ba ka jingieit bieit ka kylla nongshun, hynrei pynban ka jingshun sian ka kham bha shibun. Ymju iap thala ha T^'u nongshun ba- sian, ka iap thala ka dei ha u lok ba belt lian. Wei phi la sdang ia kano- kano ka kam kaba b^ha, phi dei ban trei ban da ithuh thikna. wat ju buh teng sah teng iaei iaei, ba ka dua lait die jot ka ioh thymmei. Na ka buh teng, sah teng ka buh por buh ia man ka teng ki ju jia ka lait kylla, nangne kein wir ka spah bad duh bynriew, bym lap khang lap set ia ka ang ba sniew. Wei la lait ka sdang, la sah ka iap-ang, kat sha ba thew pulom sa pulom naphang shaphang. la U Blei U Trai Kynrad, U Nongthaw, U Nongbuh U Ba- lah U Baiai, ki ong ba u pynneh tang kawei ka jutang ba tang ia U marwei phin mane lang. Ka mane ka nguh Blei ka long ka niam, kaba dei ia phi shyn- rang kynthei ban piam, lada phim bat ia la ka niam tynrai, la i kur i kha kumno phin sharai. Wat ju im sngi im-synia tang ha ka bam , dei ban bam ban dih tang ban im larkam lardam, uba im tang ha ka bam ka dih, dei tang u mrad bad u ba bam ba dih tang ban im shisha u dei u riewstad. Wat ju leh mynleh ba nang ba tip eh, la ha ka ktien ba kren ne kam ba leh, ka mynthi ka sngewmeng khein stad lade, kan hap pynban ha ka pute. Hang- no-hangno ruh ha khmat ki rangbah, sngew, kren bad leh rit kynthop katba lah, ap dngong ia ka ktien ba kren ki rangbah, lada ki lait ruh shu kdew ia ka nia bad to sngew khynnah, la phi nang phi stad 38 katno-kanto ruh, ka snap paka ki longshwa kam ju duh.

Ka akor ba bha koin pura syrtok, kaba lah ban teh kur teh kha da ka hok, ka akor ba bha kein ha ka pyrthci, kaba pyn- wan jingkyrkhu na U Blei. Phi dei ban kynmaw ia U Blei man ka por, uba kynthup- kynbiang bad ai bor ba kan nang-eh ka rngiew ba kan nang eh ka rwiang la jong bad lada phi leh kumta khlem pep kat phi tei ruh phin nang ioh noh nong. Nga la kren bad shim, katba ngii lah na ki jingsneng ki tym- men jong ngi, ki dang don shi- bun, hynrei katto shuwa, namar lada ngi lah ban bud ia ki mat ba la kren lyngkot mynta, ngin ioh la ka nongkylliang ba bha. Lada ngim kyndit bynriew ban ia map markylliang ban ia ieng da ka nia, ka pyrthei ka shong syier ha tniier u volcano, ba ngim tip ha kano ka por un bthei ne mano ban pyllait shuwa ia ki atom, hydrogen bombs U.S.A. ne U.S.S.R. lymda ngi pyndonkam ia ka ding ba don hapoh Jong uta u volcano na ka bynta ka jingbha u khun byn- riew. Ki ong ba lah ban ring ia ka ding bad jingkhluid u vol- cano da kaba ring ba kata ka ding kan pynsyaid ia ki iing bad ban ioh bun ki bor electric, kumjuh ruh kumba ngi lah ban pyndonkam ia ka atomic energy ne nuclear power na ka bynta ki jingbha jong ngi, kaba ki png ka lah ban pynkoit ia ki jing- pang bun jait bad wat ia ka jingmatlah, (leprosy, cancer etc. even blindness). Kaba leh da ka bor markylliang, lada lah mano-mano ym ju poi ha ka jingsuk, ka nang pynmih bun ki jingiakyn-ad ba suh sat kum- ba suhsat u sai muka. Ka jingim ka pyrthei bad u khun bynriew mynta ka shong ym ha kaba wad kput ne thombor ban ioh ia kaba phi kwah rhah, hynrei ha ka jingiapyn-i, ia kren da ka nia ka jutang bad ka map mar- kylliang, kaba yn ioh ka nong- kylliang ba thiang. Dang ha kine ki sngi phin iohi ba uwei u samla Jan Palach ha Prague haba u la sngewkut lad ban ialeh um lah shuh ia ka jing- wan ki Russia, u la pyniap ia lade bad khih buk ba ka Czech Government ka dei ban ym shah ia ka leh bor.
